headings.text: Pioneering a New Era in Cannabis

pages.bodyText:
Pioneering a New Era in Cannabis

 Welcome to The Higher Company, Syracuse’s second downtown licensed New York State dispensary. As one of the first 137 dispensaries to open in the state, we are proud to be part of a historic moment in cannabis legalization. Our mission is to provide high-quality cannabis products and create a welcoming environment for our community.

 Our Story 

 The Higher Company was founded with a vision to transform the cannabis industry and promote its benefits to a wider audience. Our founding members are proud participants in New York’s Cannabis Adult-Use Retail Dispensary (CAURD) program. Having been previously convicted for cannabis-related offenses, they have turned their past experiences into a positive force for change. Their journey from adversity to advocacy is a testament to resilience and the transformative power of cannabis.

 “We believe in the power of cannabis to enhance well-being and improve quality of life,” says Joe Sweet. “Our journey began with a passion for the plant and a commitment to providing safe, accessible, and high-quality cannabis products to our community.”

 Our Mission 

 Our mission is to deliver the highest quality cannabis products while fostering a sense of community and support. We strive to educate the public, break down stigmas, and advocate for the responsible use of cannabis. At The Higher Company, we are dedicated to:

 
 Quality : Sourcing only the best products from trusted growers and producers.

 Variety : Offering a wide range of products to meet diverse needs and preferences.

 Education : Providing accurate information and resources to help our customers make informed decisions.

 Community : Building a supportive and inclusive community through events, outreach, and advocacy.

 

 Our Products 

 At The Higher Company, quality is our top priority. We offer a diverse selection of cannabis products, including:

 
 Flower : Premium sativas, indicas, and hybrids.

 Edibles : Tasty and effective options, from gummies to baked goods.

 Concentrates : Potent and pure extracts like wax, shatter, and oils.

 Pre-Rolls : Convenient and ready-to-use pre-rolled joints.

 Topicals : Cannabis-infused lotions, balms, and creams for topical use.

 Accessories : Everything you need to enhance your cannabis experience.

 

 Community Engagement 

 We believe in giving back to our community and promoting positive change. Through our Stop the Stigma initiatives, we aim to educate the public about the benefits of cannabis and dispel common misconceptions. Join us at our events, workshops, and rallies to learn more and get involved.

pages.title: FAQS – The Higher Company
pages.bodyText:
«‎Got Questions?» 
 Frequently Asked Questions

 
 Where are you located?
 
 We are located at 123 E Willow St., Syracuse NY, 13202

 What are your hours?
 
 Hours:

 
 Sunday: 10am – 8pm

 Monday: 10am – 9pm

 Tuesday: 10am – 9pm

 Wednesday: 10am – 9pm

 Thursday: 10am – 9pm

 Friday: 10am -10pm

 Saturday: 10am – 10pm

 

 Is there parking available?
 
 Yes, you can park directly across the street in our reserved parking slots free of charge. There is also more parking under the bridge.

 Do I need a medical marijuana card to make a purchase?
 
 No you do not.

 What forms of ID are accepted?
 
 -A valid federal, state, or local government identification, including IDNYC, stating the customer’s age and featuring a photograph of the individual’s face. -A valid driver’s license or non-driver identification card issued by the department of motor vehicles, the federal government, any United States territory, commonwealth or possession, the District of Columbia, a state government within the United States, or a provincial government of the dominion of Canada. -A valid passport issued by the United States government or any other country -An identification card issued by the armed forces of the United States 

 What are my payment options?
 
 We take cash, debit cards**, Apple Pay, or Dutchie Pay (ACH) for payment. If you prefer to pay in cash, we have an ATM machine in the store. 

 We’ve partnered with the only compliant credit card solution for cannabis, and they have systems to address compliance, safety, and anti-money laundering (AML). 

 **We operate debit payments as a cashless ATM, which means when the charge is made it has to be rounded up to the nearest dollar. Once payment is made we will give you the difference in change. 

 How much can I purchase?
 
 For anyone 21 years or older, you can possess up to 3 ounces of flower, or 24 grams of cannabis concentrate, including edibles and oil, at one time. 

 Can someone else pick up my order?
 
 No. When you come to the store we will check your ID and use that to verify it’s you picking up your pre-order. 

 What is pre order?
 
 Pre-ordering is great when you want to skip the line and you know what you want. Simply place your order through our website. You can pay online using Dutchie Pay, pay via cash, or with a debit or credit card when you pick up in the store. 

 Can I place an order for pickup at the store?
 
 Yes! Just go to our thehigherco420.com, browse our extensive product selection, add items to your cart, and select the “Pick Up In-Store” option at checkout. It’s that easy! Your order will be prepared for you to pick up at The Higher Company during regular business hours. 

 Is there a minimum order for online orders?
 
 Online orders require a $50 minimum purchase. 

 Can I return a cannabis product if I’m not satisfied with it?
 
 Unfortunately, we cannot accept any returns or exchanges for any cannabis sales, due to regulations and the nature of our products. However, we are dedicated to helping you find the product that is right for you. Please talk to our budtenders to fully understand the product you are purchasing. 

 Do you deliver?
 
 We currently do not offer delivery but we are working on it. 

 Do you offer discounts or special offers?
 
 In accordance with New York State regulations, we are unable to provide discounts on our cannabis products. However, we do our best to offer competitive pricing and promotions on our non-cannabis items, such as accessories, apparel, and educational materials. Talk to our budtenders about current promotions.
